summary: Fallback presence remains transparent when native Popover APIs are unavailable
expected: Fallback overlay and Select panels reach the same visible resting motion state as native popovers
acceptanceCriteria: Fallback panels settle at opacity 1, scale 1 and zero translation with normal and reduced motion
XCA mobile menu supports pointer settings, Escape focus restoration and route navigation without forced clicks
Shared fallback regression assertions cover Vue and React overlay and Select consumers

consumers.scenario: Mobile menu in browsers without native Popover APIs

resolution: Shared Motion unifies native/fallback resting and starting states with forgiving :is(); CSS contract 59 fragments and Motion 10 unit tests pass. Shared component-interactions fallback regression: 24 passed across Vue/React, light/dark, desktop/mobile, including Select and controlled dismissal. XCA-Portal neoverse-integration: normal and reduced motion pointer settings, Escape focus restore and About navigation passed in the full browser run; header uses public contentOverflow=visible. Local workspace delivery only; no commit/publish. Portal CI pinned shared ref must be updated after this fix is committed.
